summary:
GHSA-h4h8-qgvc-m7r2: OpenJPEG decoder allocates gigabytes for the tile and
component counts of a JPEG 2000 SIZ marker regardless of the security limits.
Fixed in upstream 1.23.6 and Debian 1.23.6-1; forky 1.23.6-2, which we now
build from.
Refs:
  - https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/commit/c91d16e9
  - https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/security/advisories/GHSA-h4h8-qgvc-m7r2
  - https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/TEMP-0000000-1B5D39
